description: Scan the project and generate a single paste-ready prompt that fixes ALL findings at once, tailored to the detected AI builder (Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, v0). Requires a login on a monthly plan (`shipsafe login`). Use when the user wants one prompt to hand to their AI tool to fix everything.

path.description: Directory to scan. Defaults to the current working directory.

name: shipsafe_fix_prompt

findingCount.description: How many findings the prompt covers; 0 means there was nothing to fix.

platform.description: The AI builder the prompt is written for, or 'manual'.

prompt.description: The paste-ready fix prompt, secrets redacted. Absent when there is nothing to fix.

title: Generate a one-paste fix prompt
